Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 144. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 40 Ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Destructo Disk
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 100 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Omni
Super charge the spin of the destructo disk making it
almost unseeable to the eye.
Roll an Omni Attack Roll dealing 6d12 slashing
damage on a hit. This damage deals double damage to
structures and constructs.
